correctness.rationale: For every integer b>=3 and k>=0, a level-k block has signed total D=(b-2)^k, with exact prefix extrema H=sum_{j=0}^k(b-2)^j and m=min(0,2-k) when b=3, m=0 otherwise. The parent bigrams 01 and 10 provide opposite crossing factors with signed extremes +/- (2H-D); any moving window alters ones by at most one, so all intermediate counts occur. The k=0 two letters are treated separately. The recurrence yields rho_b(b^k)=2H-D+1. Independently enumerated complete two-block window spectra in 24 bounded (b,k) settings, not as an infinite proof; canonical seven-blob Git tree reconstructed exactly.
